name: Imouto no Onani
source:
Yuuna chan loves the elder brother indeed, dreaming of becoming his wife. Against her love, he looks her no more than just a sister. One day, Yuuna chan does "it" in his room when he is not home...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE007812.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
优奈酱确实深爱哥哥，梦想成为他的妻子。可在她的爱面前，哥哥只把她当妹妹。某天，哥哥不在房间时，优奈酱做了“那件事”……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE007812.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
